hero.title: Digitize your farm management with AgriFlow
hero.description: Track, plan, and organize your agricultural activities across different types of land and growing spaces for complete traceability of your operations.

features.title: Simplify the daily management of your agricultural operations
features.subtitle: AgriFlow addresses the daily challenges of farmers by offering digital solutions adapted to the reality of the field.

landManagement.title: Land Management
landManagement.description: Organize your plots and growing spaces according to your specific needs: rice fields, farmland, orchards or gardens.

cropTracking.title: Crop Tracking
cropTracking.description: Follow the complete lifecycle of your crops with clear statuses: fallow, in preparation, in production, growing, harvested or diseased.

agriculturalActions.title: Agricultural Actions
agriculturalActions.description: Record all your interventions (soil preparation, planting, maintenance, protection, harvesting) with dates and comments.

calendar.title: Interactive Calendar
calendar.description: Plan your future actions, configure recurring tasks and visualize your workload with our intuitive calendar.

observations.title: Observations and Weather
observations.description: Document your observations and weather conditions for a comprehensive analysis of factors influencing your crops.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Invite collaborators and assign different access levels (owner, collaborator, viewer) according to needs.

traceability.title: Traceability at the service of your crops
traceability.description: Keep a detailed history of all your actions to analyze the impact of your interventions and adopt more efficient practices.
traceability.caption: Automated tracking of agricultural interventions
